title: Dispatch envelope — outbound from agent
description:
The structured return from an autonomous agent invocation. This is what lands in the deployment's trace/attribution record. additionalProperties:false, mechanical whitelist — the field set is a stable, versioned public contract.

No prompt text, tool call arguments, response bodies, or secret values belong in this envelope. Prose and detailed artifacts live in the result artifact referenced by agent_result_path — the envelope is metadata only.

contract_revision envelope-out@2: added optional `followups[]` (see common.json#/$defs/followup). Additive-only migration -- every prior envelope-out payload (no followups key) still validates unchanged; `followups` is not in `required`. The $id path segment stays `v1` for relative-$ref-resolution reasons (see common.json's description); the tracked version number for this migration is the `contract_revision` note itself plus docs/integration.md's "Envelope contract versions" table.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration from dispatch handoff to envelope return.

cost_usd.description: Estimated cost in USD. Optional — omit if the agent does not consume metered resources.

tool_call_count.description: Total tool invocations this agent made during the run. Includes retries.

error_codes.description: Machine-readable error codes. Empty array on status=ok. Prose explanations go in the result artifact, not here.

followups.description: Optional list of follow-up work items the agent identified but did not act on (e.g. drive-by refactors returned per code-craft rule 1). Empty or omitted when there are none. Each item is a generic descriptor (common.json#/$defs/followup) -- this field carries no task-creation semantics; a deployment's own consumer decides whether and how to act on it.
